summary: Tested NEW Guardian (Brand Guardian + Marketing Score) feature end-to-end. Created /app/backend/tests/test_guardian.py (5 tests, all pass) covering POST /api/analyze/content happy path (DE+EN), history persistence (type=analysis), missing-content validation (422), and unknown-brand (404). Playwright E2E verified: sidebar has all nav items including nav-nav_guardian, dashboard shows 10 module cards including module-card-guardian, card navigates to /guardian, language toggle (DE/EN) works on /guardian, guardian-loadlast-btn populates textarea from last copy, analyze flow renders guardian-score-gauge (92/100), 5 stars, 2 progress bars (Markenkonformität/Tonalität), 5 brand checks (guardian-check-0..4) with pass/warn icons, improvements list, strengths list. Export Center filter-analysis shows 22 analysis items with score-based txt export. No issues found.
action_items: INFO: Review request states 'sidebar shows 10 items' but Layout.jsx renders 11 (Dashboard + 10 modules). The 10 module cards on dashboard are correct. No action required unless spec interpretation differs.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/analyze/content correctly excludes MongoDB '_id' via result.pop('_id', None) after insert.
Guardian.jsx component uses framer-motion + reusable Gauge/Stars/Bar sub-components — clean and small (~178 lines).
All interactive elements have data-testid (guardian-input, guardian-analyze-btn, guardian-loadlast-btn, guardian-result, guardian-score-gauge, guardian-check-{i}).
Error handling: if score/checks/improvements missing from LLM response, defaults (0 / []) are returned so UI never crashes.
Frontend uses API constant from AppContext (no hardcoded URL).
ExportCenter.jsx adds analysis to typeMeta and to filter list; itemToText branch for 'analysis' produces clean score-based txt output.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all guardian flows + nav + export filter verified)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed analysis history entries via the 2 successful POST /api/analyze/content calls. These can be filtered/deleted in Export Center under 'Analyse'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Guardian feature live at /guardian with full data-testid coverage. POST /api/analyze/content takes ~10-15s. The endpoint returns 200 with {id,type='analysis',score,verdict,brand_match,tone_match,checks[{label,status,note}],improvements[],strengths[],created_at}. History items of type='analysis' are surfaced in Export Center via export-filter-analysis. All 10 modules now implemented: dashboard, campaign, brand, social, image, copy, landing, calendar, guardian, prompts, export.
